unit.why: A single anecdote, told by the rebbetzin, about the infant R. David Moshe of Chortkov crying until his tzitzit garment was put back on, with the Ruzhiner perceiving the cause.

stories.start_quote: (ה) הרבנית הצדיקת זיווג שני של הרה"ק רד״מ
stories.end_quote: קראו אחיו את שמו דאס ציצית יודל :
stories.summary_en: The infant R. David Moshe cries without stopping; his mother asks the Ruzhiner, who laughingly says they forgot to wrap his little tzitzit garment in his swaddling, and once it is put on he calms, earning the nickname 'the tzitzit Jew'.

quotes: והלכה לקרא את הרבנית היא אמו
tags.why: mother, brothers, wife and father of the tzaddik appear

והלבישוהו את הארבע כנפות ותיכף פסק מלבכות
מען האט אודאי פארגעסין איהם אריין צו לייגען
tags.why: the Ruzhiner knows the cause without seeing it
